question: Do other bracket parameters (lower leverage 2-10x, a 7-day time stop, maker-fee take-profit exits) turn the 10-20%-on-margin take-profit loop positive, on 1-minute data this bracket idea has not been tested on?
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-13 at the user's request ('proceed with testing other parameters') after leverage-bracket-study-v1 (2024-01..2026-09) found all 72 cells negative. The new parameters were chosen after seeing v1, so they are judged primarily on 2021-01-01..2023-12-31, a period no bracket study has used (other repo studies used these prices for different strategies). 2024-01..2026-09 (v1's period, already seen) is used only as a consistency check. Descriptive mechanics study, NOT a search trial (N unchanged). No price data for 2021-2023 has been loaded for it. Paper only.
inherits: config/leverage_bracket_study_v1.json and its amendment 1 for everything not listed here: universe (research/strategy_search_v3/round2_universe.json), entries E0/E1/E2, sequential per-symbol cycle, price levels, liquidation (1/L - 0.005, loss = margin + 0.5% notional + entry fee + funding), same-bar adverse-first rule, 1m last-price high/low, funding, stale-tail rule, account (2% of realized equity per position, ruin below 50%), bootstrap settings (seed 20261013)

fee_models.F1_taker: taker 5 bps + 2 bps slippage per side on every entry and exit (as v1): 14 bps round trip
fee_models.F2_maker_take_profit: entry taker 7 bps (5 + 2 slippage); take-profit exit as a resting limit order at the TP price, maker fee 2 bps, no slippage, filled only if the 1m bar trades THROUGH the TP price by at least one tick-equivalent of 0.01% (touch-only bars do not fill; the position stays open); stop, liquidation and time-stop exits taker 7 bps

cells: 3 entries x 4 leverage x 3 take-profit x 2 stops x 2 time stops x 2 fee models = 288
outputs: as v1 per cell (trades, win rate net > 0, TP hit rate, liquidation/stop/time-stop rates, same-bar ambiguity, fees and funding per trade, net EV per trade in % of margin with day-block bootstrap 95% interval, break-even and driftless-fair win rates, realized account path, first day below 50%, P(ruin 365d)) for the primary sample and, separately, for the consistency-check sample
ruin_statistic: P(ruin) from the stationary bootstrap only when the realized account stays above zero for the whole sample; if equity reaches zero or below, report P(ruin) = 1 by definition (the historical path ruined) and the day it happened (fixes the v1 reading issue in research/leverage_bracket/NOTES.md)

reading.viable_cell: net EV per trade with a 95% lower bound above 0 in BOTH primary halves, Benjamini-Hochberg across all 288 cells at q = 0.10 on the primary sample's one-sided bootstrap p, P(ruin within 365 days) <= 5% on the primary sample, AND net EV per trade above 0 (point estimate) in the consistency-check sample
reading.otherwise: report the mechanics; no further grid after these results are seen without a new registration on data not yet used
